DURR-FULL:v1p104/r7.anchor: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حسن العهد من الإيمان

DURR-FULL:v1p104/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r8.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r8.claim: What God commands people to maintain is kinship and family ties.
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r8.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله {ويقطعون ما أمر الله به أن يوصل} قال: الرحم والقرابة

DURR-FULL:v1p104/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r9.speaker: السدي
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r9.claim: Corrupting the earth means committing sins there.
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r9.anchor: عن السدي في قوله {ويفسدون في الأرض} قال: يعملون فيها بالمعصية

DURR-FULL:v1p104/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r10.speaker: مقاتل
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r10.claim: The losers are the people of the Fire.
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r10.anchor: عن مقاتل في قوله تعالى {أولئك هم الخاسرون} يقول هم أهل النار

DURR-FULL:v1p104/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r11.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r11.claim: When God applies labels such as loser, prodigal, wrongdoer, or wicked to non-Muslims, He means unbelief; when applied to Muslims, He means sin.
DURR-FULL:v1p104/r11.anchor:
عن ابن عباس قال: كل شيء نسبه الله إلى غير أهل الإسلام من اسم
مثل خاسر ومسرف وظالم وفاسق

IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r8.claim: The pronoun refers to the covenant: the phrase means after the covenant has been confirmed and strengthened.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r8.anchor: والضمير للعهد أي من بعد توكيد العهد وتوثيقه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r9.speaker: الخفاجي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r9.claim: Al-Khafaji reads mīthāq as an intensified form of mifʿal; Ibn Ashur says its source-noun sense is more likely here.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r9.anchor: قال الخفاجي كأنه إشباع للمفعل ، وللمصدر أيضا نحو الميلاد والميعاد وهو الأظهر هنا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r10.claim: Because the covenant is unspecified and covers all pledges, its confirmation can concern a prior or subsequent pledge, like the confirmed oaths in 16:91; the mīthāq is another covenant treated as reinforcing one.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p370/r10.anchor: ولما كان المراد بالعهد عهدا غير معينن ، بل كل ما عاهدوا عليه

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p945/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p945/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p945/r1.claim: In these contexts, خلف cannot replace بعد because each expression locates something in time.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p945/r1.anchor: لا يمكننا أن نضع خلف مكان بعد ففي هذه الآيات لا يمكن أن تحلّ خلف محل بعد

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r1.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r1.claim: Ibn Qutayba lists security, a charge or bequest, an oath, and safeguarding as senses of عهد.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r1.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة : الأمان : عهد . والوصية : عهد . واليمين : عهد . والحفاظ : عهد

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r2.claim: عهد can also mean a period of time, as in the expression that something happened in someone's عهد.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r2.anchor: والزمان : عهد . يقال : كان ذلك بعهد فلان

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r3.speaker: النبي
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r3.claim: The Prophet is quoted as saying that keeping a covenant well is part of faith.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r3.anchor: قال عليه السلام : ' إن حسن العهد من الإيمان '

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r4.speaker: ابن فارس
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r4.claim: Ibn Faris defines عهد as a binding guarantee of security.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r4.anchor: وقال ابن فارس : العهد : الأمان الموثق

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r5.speaker: ابن فارس
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r5.claim: The expression عهدت إليه means that one charged or enjoined him with something.

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r6.speaker: ابن فارس
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r6.claim: المعهد can mean a dwelling or place of return when it serves as a refuge.

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r7.speaker: ابن فارس
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r7.claim: عهد can denote the person who makes a covenant with someone.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r7.anchor: والعهد : الذي يعاهدك والعهدة : وثيقة المتبايعين

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r8.speaker: ابن فارس
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r8.claim: العهدة is the written document between buyers and sellers; in a matter, عهدة can instead be an unresolved issue.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r8.anchor: والعهدة : وثيقة المتبايعين ، وفي الأمر عهدة : لم يحكم بعد

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r9.speaker: ابن فارس
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r9.claim: تعهد means to take care of something and renew one's commitment to it.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r9.anchor: والتعهد : الاحتفاظ بالشيء وتجديد العهد به

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r10.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r10.claim: One says تعهدت ضيعتي, not تعاهدت, because reciprocal تعاهد requires two people.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r10.anchor: ويقولون : تعهدت ضيعتي ولا يقولون تعاهدت . لأن التعاهد لا يكون إلا من اثنين

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r11.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r11.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r11.claim: The entry also gives عهد as a term for rain, whose name is linked to its being the first rain to mark the land.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r11.anchor: وسمي لأنه أول ما عهد الأرض ]

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r12.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r12.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r12.claim: The first Qur'anic sense is a charge or bequest; the entry applies it to God's covenant in 2:27 and cites God's charge to Adam's children.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r12.anchor: أحدها : الوصية . ومنه قوله تعالى في البقرة : ﴿ الذين ينقضون عهد الله من بعد ميثاقه ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r13.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r13.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r13.claim: A second Qur'anic sense is a guarantee of security, illustrated by the treaty-guarantee in 9:4.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r13.anchor: والثاني : الأمان . ومنه قوله تعالى في براءة : ﴿ فأتموا إليهم عهدهم إلى مدتهم ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r14.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r14.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r14.claim: A third Qur'anic sense is keeping faith or fulfilling a commitment, illustrated in 7:102.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r14.anchor: والثالث : الوفاء . ومنه قوله تعالى في الأعراف : ﴿ وما وجدنا لأكثرهم من عهد ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r15.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r15.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r15.claim: A fourth Qur'anic sense is monotheism: taking a عهد with the Merciful means affirming God's oneness with لا إله إلا الله.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r15.anchor: والرابع : التوحيد . ومنه قوله تعالى في مريم : ﴿ إلا من اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا ﴾ ، أي : وحده بقول

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r16.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r16.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r16.claim: Ibn Qutayba takes عهد in 16:91 to mean an oath.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r16.anchor: والخامس : اليمين . ومنه قوله تعالى في النحل : ﴿ وأوفوا بعهد الله إذا عاهدتم ﴾ ، قاله : ابن قتيبة

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r17.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r17.speaker: غيره
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r17.claim: Another view reads عهد in 16:91 as an agreement to do something.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r17.anchor: وقال غيره : هو من المعاهدة على فعل الشيء

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r18.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r18.speaker: الحسن
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r18.claim: Al-Hasan interprets the عهد to Abraham and Ishmael as revelation from God.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r18.anchor: قاله : الحسن . وألحقه بعضهم بالقسم الأول

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r19.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r19.speaker: بعضهم
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r19.claim: Some exegetes attach revelation to the first, charge-or-bequest sense because the meanings are close.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r19.anchor: وألحقه بعضهم بالقسم الأول ، ومعناهما متقارب

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r20.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r20.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r20.claim: A seventh Qur'anic sense is prophethood, as in God's statement that His عهد does not reach wrongdoers.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p446/r20.anchor: والسابع : النبوة . ومنه قوله تعالى في البقرة : ﴿ قال لا ينال عهدي الظالمين ﴾

BURHAN:v3p439/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p439/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p439/r1.claim: Describing a covenant as something broken evokes a rope and its links, metaphorically presenting the covenant as a bond between parties.
BURHAN:v3p439/r1.anchor: فنبه بالنقض الذي هو من توابع الحبل وروادفه على أنه قد استعار للعهد الحبل

ITQAN:v3p122/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p122/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p122/r5.claim: In a metaphor by insinuation, the covenant is implicitly likened to a rope; “undo” signals the unspoken comparison.
ITQAN:v3p122/r5.anchor: شبه العهد بالحبل وأضمر في النفس فلم يصرح بشيء من أركان التشبيه سوى العهد المشبه

DAMGHANI:v1p385/r7.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p385/r7.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p385/r7.claim: Qaṭʿ can mean breaking the rights of relatives, that is, severing kinship ties.
DAMGHANI:v1p385/r7.anchor: الرابع : القطع ترك حق الأقارب قوله تعالى في سورة البقرة

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p502/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p502/r6.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p502/r6.claim: Qaṭʿ can mean severing kinship and family ties.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p502/r6.anchor: والرابع : قطع الرحم والقرابة . ومنه قوله تعالى في البقرة
